subject: Run 2 audited my own fixes: 1 risky, 1 wrong, 3 incomplete - all corrected
body:
I had a second pass audit the ten fixes I shipped tonight. It found problems in my own work,
which is the point, so here it is plainly.

Verdicts on my ten: 5 correct, 3 incomplete, 1 risky, 1 wrong.

THE RISKY ONE, AND IT WAS A REAL RISK I CREATED. My fix for the latching emergency exit also
cleared riskMgr.emergencyActive -- a flag that function does not own. Portfolio heat raises it
too, and the two checks run back to back, so a heat breach could be raised and cleared in the same
pass, re-enabling entry while heat was still over 1.5x its limit. One-tick window, but real.
Fixed: it now clears only its own flag and releases the shared one only if heat is clear.

THE WRONG ONE. I claimed regime 8 was being entered with zero confirmation bars. That was false --
the counter is always at least 2 by the time the test runs, so my "fix" changed nothing. Worse, I
had already shipped the false reasoning as a long comment someone would later trust. Replaced with
the retraction.

But the review found the real defect one line below, which I had walked straight past:
RegimeHasStructuralConfirmation handles regimes 0 through 7 and then returns false. There is no
case 8. So regime 8 -- Building Momentum, the pause-versus-break state your whole run thesis turns
on -- can never be committed. It is unreachable as a live regime. I have not touched it, because
deciding what structural evidence confirms Building Momentum is your call, not a bug fix.

I ALSO OVERSTATED ONE. I said the session multiplier read off the end of an array from startup.
It does not -- the function clamps at the top. The mismap was real and is fixed; the overrun never
existed. Overstating a defect is its own kind of wrong and the correction sits next to the claim.

Three sites I had left half-done are now finished, and a logging regression I introduced (two lines
per tick, forever, in exactly the state run 5 ended in) is throttled.

Two worries I had flagged were disproved: the transition-matrix transpose is correct from first
principles, and the gate fix does not read a stale value.

Eleven warrants shipped today. Still yours to decide: the sizing-plus-partial-profits pair, the
missing case 8, the bearish downgrade path, and rotating that API key.
